title: Venezuela's rebound of oil activity under the US's 'neocolonial' control

Civil society groups have also denounced the lack of economic benefits for oil and gas-producing regions.

title: 'Changing your breasts is changing your life': How breast surgery can profoundly transform women
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (2/5). What if breast surgery changed both self-image and self-perception? Whether rebuilding after cancer or for aesthetic reasons, women never come out of it quite the same. Le Monde spent several weeks behind closed doors in a private breast surgery practice in Paris.

title: Hungary: Questions emerge over Péter Magyar's rapid dismantling of Orban's legacy

title: Crimea, a peninsula of memories: 'What do we have left from there? Nothing. Everything is in the heart'
